agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 OverallRankingALL listing contains the exact institution row with Jabalpur and Madhya Pradesh.
The Jabalpur official domain is www.mangalayatan.ac.in; the similarly named www.mangalayatan.in site identifies the Aligarh campus and was excluded.
The official catalogue is distributed across the current admissions landing page, departmental programme tables, and programme detail pages; duplicate programme rows were deduplicated.

Official pages have conflicting or template-inconsistent duration and eligibility values for some entries, notably agriculture table versus detail pages, B.Pharma, and business specializations. Conflicting specialization eligibility fields were left null, and dedicated detail-page values were used where available.
No separate certificate programme was found in the official homepage, sitemap, admissions landing page, or department programme tables reviewed.

Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests were then retried with curl --insecure only against the expected NIRF, official university, and search hostnames.
